text:
- The iOS device home feed uses PLAIN `ActiveUserFollows`, built in Swift (`KernelBridge+FeedOperations.swift:51`), NOT the difference composition. My `control` test proves that path is sound.
- The `Difference(follows, mute)` composition exists only in the Rust Android/desktop/TUI shells of the newest worktrees (`chirp/.wt-*`, branch chirp-android-platform 7be5d64). Its `home_feed_params` = RootIndexed / primary_kinds [1] / admission All. Also sound per my test. [...] The difference composition FAILS TO OPEN before an active account exists: `ScopeNotSupportedYet { scope: "ListMembers-active-mute-no-active-account" }` (nip51_sources.rs:130-132, mute source is RequireActive). Plain follows opens fine pre-login (AllowMissingActive) and just shows empty. So the Rust shells that open the home feed with the difference scope get a hard open-error if they open before sign-in, whereas iOS/plain-follows degrades gracefully. This is a Chirp-composition fragility, not the empty-feed symptom (the device DID open + emit a snapshot).
